article.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work

Watermarking uses low-stakes choices like these—which occur many times over a piece of generated text—to leave a pattern in Claude’s responses.

article.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
article.summary:
